name: speko
description: Transcribe audio, synthesize speech, and place real phone calls through one Speko account.

skills.name: speko-phone-call
skills.description: Place a real outbound phone call through Speko and read back what was said. Use when the user wants someone actually called on the telephone — booking, confirming, chasing, asking a business a question — or wants to rehearse such a call first, or wants to review a call that already happened.
